source.audio: Native recordings only under a license allowing redistribution (CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0), each with its own license and contributor; files in apps/mobile_flutter/assets/audio/tatoeba/<audio id>.mp3, from https://tatoeba.org/audio/download/<audio id>.

english.varietyNote: US/GB not distinguished by Tatoeba; the English track treats both as one variety.

japanese.varietyNote: Kanji/kana as written by contributors; furigana/romaji must be generated and reviewed.

spanish-spain.varietyNote: Tatoeba does not tag Spain vs Latin American Spanish; pass --variety and let reviewers reject cross-variety rows.
